edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with _from and used in allowance[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
msg.sender gates batchSend and its balanceOf entry is debited.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before delegatecall.
list requires msg.sender == owner and sends liquidity to msg.sender.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants msg.sender pair allowance.
ensure allows any caller whose tx.origin passes the owner/isAccountValid checks.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the router deadline in list.
owner is the sole authority allowed to invoke delegate.
owner is the sole authority allowed to invoke batchSend.
owner is the sole authority allowed to invoke list.
uniPair is one of the hard-coded addresses accepted by the ensure modifier.
batchSend debits and credits balanceOf entries with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
list() overwrites balances using totalSupply * 6 / 100 with no SafeMath.
uniRouter receives the external addLiquidityETH call from list.
Unchecked _value * _tos.length result feeds the balance accounting of batchSend.
Unchecked balance and allowance updates are the arithmetic core of transferFrom.
Only the owner-derived msg.sender can reach the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter a is the arbitrary delegatecall target.
Parameter b is the arbitrary delegatecall calldata.
ensure invokes isAccountValid(tx.origin) as part of its allow-list expression.
isAccountValid reads the address bytes through sliceUint assembly.
constructor derives uniPair by calling pairFor.
Parameter subject is the address hashed and modulo-tested by isAccountValid.
ensure modifier guards entry into transferFrom.
batchSend executes the unchecked multiplication of the per-recipient value.
transferFrom executes unchecked balance and allowance updates.
list performs an external call through the uniRouter address.
transfer forwards the call to transferFrom.
onlyByHundred requires isAccountValid(msg.sender).
delegatecall hands execution to attacker-controlled code inside the token context, enabling reentrant state manipulation.
